page: Amazon Web Services g7.8xlarge is a graphics-intensive GPU instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. Powered by a dedicated 32-core x86_64 Intel processor operating at 3.9 GHz without hyperthreading, it maps 32 vCPUs directly to 32 physical cores. System memory comprises 128 GB, yielding a 4 GB RAM per physical core ratio.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPU equipped with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local ephemeral storage features a 930 GB NVMe SSD attached directly to the host, offering fast access for local cache and scratch files. Network interconnect performance is anchored by a high-throughput 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

The 1:1 thread-to-core mapping minimizes contention across execution units, yielding consistent single-core latency. Combining a Blackwell-generation GPU, 128 GB of RAM, 930 GB of local NVMe storage, and 100 Gbps networking, the instance is structured for 3D visualization, graphics rendering, video encoding, and medium-scale AI inference workloads.
